flags.note: ICICI Bank's reported PoS terminals dropped from 21.5 lakh to 1.6 lakh and its Bharat QR count to zero in Jun-26, while its ATM, card and spending figures stayed normal. Treated as a reporting reclassification, not a real change in the network.
